newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Nippecraft tops active with 11 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Nippecraft tops active with 11 mln shares.

text.p: Diary maker Nippecraft led the actives with 11.2 million shares in late Friday trade on syndicate trading, dealers said.
At 0805 GMT, the stock was up S$0.07 to S$0.705.
"There is no news linked to the company that I know of that could be causing the volumes on Nippecraft," a dealer with a European bank said.
"It is more syndicates trying to ramp up the stock and I think there are more selling than buying," another dealer said.
Maker and supplier of injection moulds and parts Fu Yu Ltd was also among the actives, with 4.3 million shares. It was up S$0.03 to S$0.595.
Dealers said renewed interest in electronic stocks could have led to the activity on Fu Yu.
However, they felt the activity was unlikely to be sustained beyond one to two days due to a lack of fundamental support.
